title: 16.43. Atītārammaṇattika, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Atītārammaṇaṁ hetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naatītārammaṇo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā ekavīsa, ārammaṇe nava …pe… aññamaññe sattarasa …pe… avigate ekavīsa.
Atītārammaṇaṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naanāgatārammaṇo nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā nava …pe… avigate nava.
